validation_notes: From late June through late July price has been moving sideways in a tight range (~0.0044-0.0050) rather than converging into an apex. There's no clear descending upper trendline with lower highs - the highs in July are roughly flat/choppy, not declining, and the lows are also flat rather than rising. This looks more like a flat consolidation/basing range after a steep downtrend than a descending triangle. The algorithm may be picking up on the overall downtrend from May into June feeding into this range, but the right-edge structure lacks the clear converging trendlines needed for a credible triangle - there's no discernible apex forming, and touches on both sides are at similar levels rather than converging.
